name: Elneth Lumeith
keeps: the crossing, and the six months between
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: "The dose makes the poison" is his, and it is the founding sentence of toxicology.
text: Elneth lumeith of the ninth arch, carries between for the 21th tranche, doors 191 to 200. Keeps the crossing, and the six months between. Reads Paracelsus.
